items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: That's what Judd Perry (PHONETIC) made a record out of.

ctx.x: down in there called The Subway. And the guys used to go down there and jam. And the guy that ran it was named Piney Brown (PHONETIC). I don't know if you've ever heard that name.
Yeah. Because Of Pine Brown's Worms. That's what Judd Perry (PHONETIC) made a record out of.
